pages.title: Aquatic Salvage Project
pages.summary: First Transstar assignment: undersea salvage aboard the TSS Profondeur, beginning with Hadal Research Site.

pages.title: Carlos
pages.summary: Old Navy acquaintance associated with a poker game on the Venture; possibly connected to future jump contacts.

pages.title: Claire Bouchard
pages.summary: Transstar Highport Operations Manager who processed the party after their employment tests.

pages.title: Dolphin Extremists
pages.summary: Earlier Transstar label for aquatic opposition later clarified as broader undersea extremists.

pages.title: Elena Verona
pages.summary: Social Solidarity commissar who responded to the Mercier assassination scene and survived the group's escape.

pages.title: Étienne Valcourt
pages.summary: Captain and pilot of the TSS Profondeur; former Jardin Navy submersible-operations specialist.

pages.title: False News Broadcast
pages.summary: A fabricated broadcast blamed Mercier's murder on genetic outcasts and falsely showed Zoy attacking the minister.

pages.title: Friday Party Congress Hearing
pages.summary: Upcoming internal hearing where contacts may reveal who is shaping the official story after Mercier's death.

pages.title: Hadal Research Site
pages.summary: Damaged Transstar undersea research facility attacked before the party's first salvage mission.

pages.title: Jardin Navy
pages.summary: Planetary naval force tied to the Hadal survivors and the wider Mercier conspiracy.

pages.title: Jardinian Naval SOS
pages.summary: Encrypted military distress signal Emma discovers while training on Profondeur communications.

pages.title: Keith Morris
pages.summary: Corporate executive contact of Judith Dumont who advised that direct off-world escape from Jardin is blocked by identity controls.

pages.title: Maëlle Fournier
pages.summary: Engineer and damage-control specialist aboard the TSS Profondeur.

pages.title: Mercier Lookalike Survivor
pages.summary: Unidentified Jardin Navy survivor rescued from Hadal who closely resembles assassinated minister Alain Mercier.

pages.title: Relay Station 932
pages.summary: Primary undersea communications relay used by Transstar ships and orbital links.

pages.title: Rémi Beauchamp
pages.summary: Sonar, sensors, electronics, and communications specialist aboard the TSS Profondeur.

pages.title: Sabine Caron
pages.summary: Security and diving-operations lead aboard the TSS Profondeur.

pages.title: Session 4 - Into the Hadal Deep
pages.summary: The party begins underwater salvage aboard the TSS Profondeur, rescues a Mercier lookalike from Hadal, and draws SolSec attention at Undersea Base Elyon.

pages.title: SolSec Operative at Elyon
pages.summary: Unidentified SolSec agent who scans the Mercier lookalike survivor at Undersea Base Elyon.

pages.title: TSS Profondeur
pages.summary: Refitted former Jardin Navy submersible used by Transstar for the Aquatic Salvage Project.

pages.title: Undersea Base Elyon
pages.summary: Transstar-owned undersea base with ship airlock, repair capacity, and emergency medical response.

pages.title: Undersea Extremists
pages.summary: Aquatic attackers opposed to Transstar undersea operations, including humanoids and cybernetically enhanced orcas.

pages.title: Undersea Suits
pages.summary: Pressure-rated diving suits used by Transstar crews for salvage and underwater combat.
